messages:
Maya: posted new micro-prototype for trace header: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/trace-header-compact
Maya: intent: reduce noise, fold stack traces by default, add single primary action 'Save capture' that defaults to JSON
Theo: keep format options in kebab, users still expect HAR/JSON. tooltip clarifies default
Priya: prefer 'Save capture' for broader audience. tooltip: 'Quick save (JSON). Use menu for HAR/full bundle.'
Vik: ops: bundling KV huge. show estimated size + span count before download and queue big jobs. signed url TTL=600s
Maya: added size chip: '~ 4.8 MB · 3,402 spans' that updates with filters
a11y-bot: contrast auto-check: size-chip 2.9:1 on 1945678930, needs 4.5:1 for small text
Priya: bump weight & darken background. add aria-live='polite' to size updates so screen readers announce changes
Theo: keyboard order should be Search → Filters → CTA → Kebab. ensure kebab reachable by keyboard
Maya: added collapsed correlation-id pill (first 8 chars + ellipsis) with hover to reveal & copy, plus pin to persist
Vik: telemetry events: trace_export_clicked, export_type, span_count; track full bundle usage
Maya: decision: primary 'Save capture' (JSON), kebab for formats, estimated size + span count, permission modal for sensitive exports, contrast + aria-live fixes. I'll update figma and add annotation checklist.
